hook: Kieron Pollard is Mumbai Indians' new *head coach*. MI haven't won since 2020
tldr: Mumbai Indians promoted batting coach Kieron Pollard to head coach, replacing Mahela Jayawardene after a disappointing IPL 2026. MI have gone six editions without a title.

beats.what: Pollard, part of all five MI titles, takes over from Jayawardene, whose two-season second stint ended after IPL 2026.
beats.why: MI chose continuity over a full overhaul. Pollard is close to Rohit Sharma and Hardik Pandya, who have led MI at different times.
beats.care: Expect MI retention and release news soon, amid talk of some big names being let go.

cards.body: MI co-owner Nita Ambani: "Polly knows what it means to wear the MI jersey and what it takes to play for the Paltan." Rohit Sharma may get a bigger say in team decisions.

cards.q: Can Pollard end MI's title drought?
When did Mumbai Indians last win the IPL?
cards.why: Their fifth title came in 2020; they've gone six editions without one since.

viz.l: IPL titles MI won, all with Pollard in the side

learn.t: Before each IPL auction, teams submit a list of players they retain; everyone else goes into the auction pool.

watch: MI's retention list and who joins Pollard's support staff.
